A museum with Korean historical artifacts. The main attraction here is the Donggukjeongun, a set of six books from the 15th century describing how Chinese characters should be pronounced. These were the first such teaching books in Korea.
You can enjoy this beautiful lake, Ilgam-ho M-F only 05:00-08:00, because of the students' security. But you can visit here at 05:00-17:00 every weekends.
It is a space where you can experience various experience facilities through children's play.
Tteokbokki, a Korean dish, is delicious here. It's spicy, so be careful.
This is the most famous dumpling restaurant in Gwangjin-gu. It sells out early almost every day, so it's best to get there when it opens.
A restaurant that serves sashimi, sushi, and rice bowls. There's always a wait, so I recommend getting there early to get on the waiting list and snapping photos at the selfie shop next door.
A place that sells rice noodles. It feels like a mix between Korea and Japan.
A bar where you can enjoy cocktails with live entertainment.
It's a Korean-style bar that serves makgeolli, a Korean liquor, as well as sueyuk and seafood pajeon.

This is a Seongsu-dong cafe that offers unique menus such as mango bingsu and salt bread sandwiches.In particular, raw mango shaved ice is large and fresh, and Jambong Bör sandwich and egg mayo sandwich using salt bread are also popular…
